Messages.Author: David Hyatt
Messages.Body:
I have a rules question for the Jyhad experts out there
(being somewhat new to the game)...

Suppose that one player attempts to bleed another player.
The victim has two vampires, A and B. He decides to
block with A.

The player attempting the bleed pumps his stealth and
gets by vampire A.

Now I understand that no other vampire can attempt to
block, but can another vampire play REACTION cards?
Can Vampire B play Deflection or Telepathic Misdirection?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <d-hyatt....@ta8.cs.uiuc.edu>,


Other vampires can attempt to block just fine.
Others can also play reaction cards, as well.
